name: Wave
summary: Wave lets small businesses create unlimited invoices on a free Starter plan and pay only when customers pay by card. Card payments cost 2.9% + $0.60 on Starter, and the Pro plan at $19 a month adds late payment reminders and custom branding.

facts.text: Starter includes unlimited estimates, invoices, bills and bookkeeping records for $0.
On Pro, the first ten cumulative card transactions in a monthly period cost 2.9% with no fixed fee, and later ones cost 2.9% + $0.60.
Pro adds automatic bank transaction import, automated late payment reminders and customizable invoice branding.
Discover processing is available only to US customers.

volumeFee.basis: per Visa, Mastercard or Discover payment; Amex 3.4% + $0.60
per card payment for the first 10 each monthly period, then + $0.60; Amex 3.4%

hiddenCosts: Add-ons such as payroll and bookkeeping are priced separately, and the pricing page does not map every add-on figure to a plan.
